title: PistonAngles
description: Place pistons facing any direction you choose without having to look that way. Set a direction in the config or cycle it with a keybind, and every piston you place points where you want — even on servers.
body:
# Piston Angle

Tired of contorting your camera just to make a piston face the right way? Piston Angle lets you **lock piston placement to any direction** — down, up, north, south, east, west — no matter where you're actually looking.

## Features

- 🎯 **Force piston facing** — pick a direction and every piston you place points that way. Covers regular **and sticky pistons**.
- ⚙️ **Config screen** — set the direction through [Mod Menu](https://modrinth.com/mod/modmenu), or leave it on **Auto** for 100% vanilla behavior.
- ⌨️ **Quick-cycle keybind** — press **V** (rebindable) to cycle directions on the fly. The current direction flashes on your actionbar, so you never open a menu mid-build.
- 🌐 **Works on servers** — placement direction is applied in a server-friendly way, so pistons keep their forced facing on multiplayer servers without the mod installed, and it plays nice with anticheats.
- 💾 Setting persists across sessions (`config/pistonmod.json`).

## How to use

1. Drop the jar in your `mods` folder (Fabric API required, Mod Menu optional).
2. Press **V** in-game to cycle: Auto → Down → Up → North → South → West → East.
3. Place pistons. That's it.

## Requirements

| | |
|---|---|
| Minecraft | 1.21.10 – 1.21.11 |
| Loader | Fabric 0.17+ |
| Depends | Fabric API |
| Optional | Mod Menu (config screen) |
